lead: Competitive activity across aviation software vendors highlights ongoing product releases and EFB platform adoptions, with Jeppesen and Lufthansa Systems capturing significant feed visibility.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Capabilities
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced new Airflow agents, such as Trip Feasibility and Ops Briefing, for its ForeFlight Dispatch platform at NBAA-BACE 2026.
insights.aviation_context: Business aviation platforms are incorporating automated dispatch tools to streamline pre-flight planning.
insights.caveat: Source announcements focus on business aviation feature additions rather than commercial airline fleet deployments.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Lido Solutions
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems implemented its Lido Flight 4D solution for Kenya Airways and deployed its Lido mPilot EFB for Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Airlines continue to adopt digital flight planning and iOS-based electronic flight bag applications for cockpit crews.
insights.caveat: Evidence is drawn from vendor announcements and captured customer implementations.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple EFB Adoptions
insights.finding: IFS secured customer adoptions for its IFS EFBOne platform from carriers including fastjet, TUS Airways, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: Carriers adopt electronic flight bag software to centralize flight-reporting workflows across various aircraft fleets.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect captured contract wins and deployments reported within feed windows.
